## Gotchas

- **No AI attribution, anywhere.** Commits, PR titles and bodies credit Sean only; the
  content policy blocks co-author trailers and generated-with footers, and the agent
  guard hook refuses publishing commands that contain them (even inside a grep pattern).
- **Agents can't change shared settings.** Netlify site settings, ruleset toggles and
  force-pushes are refused by the permission classifier even with chat approval. Hand
  Sean the exact commands instead.
- **Auto-merge merges immediately** when every required check has already passed.
- **lefthook on Windows** wraps `run:` in `sh -c "..."`: keep hook commands on one line
  with single quotes only.
- **The `harness` launcher is stale** (points at `Documents\websites\harness`). Re-run
  `install.ps1` in `Documents\src\harness`; until then use
  `C:\Users\seanf\Documents\src\harness\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m harness`.
- **Headless screenshots**: use `npx vite preview` (port 4173) with a fresh
